questions.question: If other vehicles have trouble passing your truck on a road with two or more lanes, you should:
questions.explanation: Stay in the right lane on a multilane road if your truck is moving slowly. This lets other vehicles pass you using the left lane.

questions.question: Texting while driving is dangerous because:

options.text: It takes your attention and your hands off the road.
A message may upset the driver.
People may become too focused on their phones.

questions.correctAnswerText: It takes your attention and your hands off the road.
questions.explanation: Texting while driving is dangerous because it distracts your mind from the road and requires you to take at least one hand off the steering wheel.

questions.question: What do both systems in a dual air brake system share?
questions.explanation: Both systems share one air compressor. If the compressor breaks, neither system will work.

questions.question: What is commonly found in compressed air?
questions.explanation: Compressed air usually contains water and compressor oil. These can damage the brakes if they build up. Tanks must be drained regularly to prevent this.

questions.question: At the end of a vehicle control skills test, your vehicle should be:

options.text: In the general area the examiner described.
In the exact position the examiner described.
Within three feet of the position the examiner described.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact position the examiner described.
questions.explanation: You must finish each exercise with your vehicle in the exact position the examiner described. Not doing this can result in failing the skills test.

questions.question: What is brake lag?

options.text: The time it takes for brakes to work after you press the brake pedal
The space between the brake pedal and the floor
The amount of air pressure used to stop the vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: The time it takes for brakes to work after you press the brake pedal
questions.explanation: Air brakes cannot start working instantly because air takes time to travel through the lines. There is usually a delay of at least one-half second between pressing the brake pedal and the brakes starting to work.

questions.question: A driver should make sure:

options.text: Cargo is mostly in the front of the trailer.

questions.explanation: Proper cargo loading is essential for safe truck operation. Poor loading can affect how the truck handles, damage it, or cause cargo to fall and injure people.

questions.question: What is axle weight?

options.text: The weight pressing down on the ground from one axle
The maximum weight an axle can hold

questions.correctAnswerText: The weight pressing down on the ground from one axle
questions.explanation: Axle weight is the weight pressing down on the ground from one axle or set of axles.

questions.question: Eating while driving:

options.text: Is a good idea on long trips.

questions.explanation: Eating while driving is dangerous because it takes your attention away from the road and requires you to remove a hand from the steering wheel.

questions.question: While driving, you should:

options.text: Not use mirrors because they are distracting.
Only check mirrors when there is traffic.

questions.explanation: You need to stay aware of everything around you at all times. Check your mirrors regularly to do this.

questions.question: When you double your speed from 20 mph to 40 mph, how does this affect your braking distance?
questions.explanation: When you double your speed from 20 to 40 mph, your braking distance becomes four times longer. Higher speeds require much longer distances to stop.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Speed up and slow down often.
Change your driving to match the weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your driving to match the weather.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, adjust your speed to match road conditions. Your vehicle takes longer to stop on slippery roads, so increase your distance from other vehicles. Avoid changing speeds often.

questions.question: When you stop, how should you press the brake pedal?
questions.explanation: Press the brake pedal down slowly when stopping. Slow, gradual braking helps you keep control of your vehicle.

questions.question: Why is rolling backward when you start to move forward dangerous?

options.text: You may hit a vehicle behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may hit a vehicle behind you.
questions.explanation: Make sure you can move forward without rolling backward. Rolling backward can cause you to hit a vehicle or object behind your truck.

questions.question: Before a bus enters a curve, the driver should:
questions.explanation: Always slow down before entering a curve. Be extra careful if the road is wet or slippery.

questions.question: When using a turn signal, you should not:

options.text: Leave the signal on long after the turn is done.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave the signal on long after the turn is done.
questions.explanation: Signal well before you turn or change lanes. Keep the signal on during your turn, then turn it off right after. Leaving the signal on confuses other drivers.

questions.question: Air brake systems usually contain some water and compressor oil. This water and oil:

options.text: Are needed for the system to work properly.
Should make up about 10 percent of the tank.

questions.explanation: Water and oil buildup can damage an air brake system. Air tanks have drains to remove this buildup. Open the drains at the end of each driving day.

questions.question: What is the main cause of death and injury in work zones?
questions.explanation: Speeding is the leading cause of death and injury in work zones. Drive carefully and slowly near workers.

questions.question: One way to prevent drowsiness while driving is to:

options.text: Get enough sleep the night before your trip.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get enough sleep the night before your trip.
questions.explanation: Getting a full night of sleep before driving is important. Other ways to prevent drowsiness include having someone with you, driving during hours when you are normally awake, and avoiding medicines that cause sleepiness. Regular exercise also helps you stay alert.

questions.question: When should you check and adjust your mirrors?
questions.explanation: Check and adjust your mirrors before you start to drive. Your body position changes each day, so your mirrors may need to be adjusted.
